name: BuildEcom
author: buildecomteam

sections.description:
BuildEcom enables WooCommerce store owners to build and integrate mobile eCommerce applications powered by Firebase notifications and REST API support. This plugin serves as a bridge between your WordPress WooCommerce store and the BuildEcom mobile app infrastructure.

Key Features:

  • Connect your WooCommerce store with the BuildEcom mobile app builder
  • Push notifications via Firebase (FCM)
  • Custom API endpoints for mobile app integration
  • Device token management for logged-in users
  • Supports all default WooCommerce product types

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it from the WordPress Plugin Repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to BuildEcom in the WordPress admin menu to configure API credentials and Firebase settings.
  4. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and activated for BuildEcom to function.

Is Firebase required?

Yes. Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) is used to send push notifications to mobile app users.

Does this plugin support multi-vendor plugins?

Currently, the plugin is designed for single-store WooCommerce setups.
